page_title: AgentGPT: Autonomous AI in your browser 🤖

summary.name: AgentGPT
summary.one_liner: AgentGPT is a browser-based tool for configuring and deploying autonomous AI agents that break a user-given goal into tasks, execute them, and learn from the results.
use_cases: Generate a research report on a company
Create a study plan for an exam
Break a broad goal into executable tasks
summary.what_it_does:
AgentGPT lets the user name a custom AI agent and give it a goal. The agent reasons about tasks to perform, executes them, and uses the results to continue toward the goal. The page offers example agents: ResearchGPT for company reports, TravelGPT for trip planning, and StudyGPT for exam study plans. The interface shows a run counter (0 of 5 runs) and fields for name, tools, and goal. The page text does not describe further technical details.</what_it_does>
